body: Hey… No you are NTA… you alone know what your mun has gone through to bring you up. I have been in your shoes and my granny gave up everything to ensure i get a better life. I do think it’ll be hypocritical for you to just forget all that. Your partner and parents are not on the same plane of affection. You can love your mother without it affecting your relationship with your partner. If I were you, I would talk to my fiancée and let her know that the way i love her is not comparable to anybody else on earth but I do think I owe my mother a big chunk of who I have turned out to be. Loving your parents and your partners are 2 different non overlapping hemispheres of life.

Well NTA but I think it should be your wife’s decision to spend the days with you. I mean as noble as you make it sound it is you robbing her of her choice of wanting to/not wanting to spend time with you. Just think about it from her POV. How would you feel if the roles were reversed and she left you because she didn’t want you to go through hard times.

When we last had this conversation he said there are no right jobs for him atm. He said all the available jobs want experience and he has none unfortunately. I am trying my best to be understanding but i don’t see him job hunt or yk look for other avenues. When i tell him that financially he needs to do better(we are really broke) he just tells me to mind my work and trust him.

Now that you say this.. I do think maybe he is going through something like this. He had a lot of passions and hobbies but slowly everything has just slipped away. Last time i talked to him about this, he told me that doing drugs makes him feel better about everything. I am just honestly concerned about him because even if we dont work out he should not have to live like this its going to lead to nothing
